# Condition Expression

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ConditionExpression`](gmeow-ConditionExpression.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ConditionExpression>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A machine formalization of a condition in a named expression language. STORED, NEVER EXECUTED: no CI step, test, or tool may evaluate a [`ConditionExpression`](gmeow-ConditionExpression.md) against the graph as part of validation ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12) made operational). Attaching one to a [`Condition`](gmeow-Condition.md) ([`gmeow:formalizedAs`](../properties/gmeow-formalizedAs.md)) is a claim that the expression captures the prose — a claim like any other, carrying confidence and vantage through the statement layer.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ConditionExpression`](gmeow-ConditionExpression.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to carry a machine formalization of a condition in a named expression language — SPARQL ASK, CEL, Rego, Cedar, XACML, SHACL — as a stored, challengeable equivalence claim.

### Avoid when

- Avoid evaluating it against the graph during validation (stored, never executed — [Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)) and avoid treating it as the canonical condition; the prose [`gmeow:conditionText`](../properties/gmeow-conditionText.md) is canonical.

### How to use

- Mint the expression with [`gmeow:expressionText`](../properties/gmeow-expressionText.md) and [`gmeow:expressionLanguage`](../properties/gmeow-expressionLanguage.md), attach it to a [`gmeow:Condition`](gmeow-Condition.md) via [`gmeow:formalizedAs`](../properties/gmeow-formalizedAs.md), and carry the equivalence claim's confidence and vantage on the statement layer.

### Examples

- ex:e1 a [`gmeow:ConditionExpression`](gmeow-ConditionExpression.md); [`gmeow:expressionLanguage`](../properties/gmeow-expressionLanguage.md) [`gmeow:exprLangSparqlAsk`](../individuals/gmeow-exprLangSparqlAsk.md); [`gmeow:expressionText`](../properties/gmeow-expressionText.md) "ASK { ?s ex:requestedErasure true }".
